data.text: You take no damage this action. Channel: put a Concentration token every action over the effect for the action's duration.

logic.description: Implemented as a channel (general_ux_channeling, 2026-10-29). I take no damage on the cast action and on every subsequent action while I keep the Concentration channel (no A/B/M/EM, no other element); a Concentration bonus token goes on my tile. ∀: instant.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

general_ux_channeling: the channel stands while the caster neither Attacks, Blocks, Moves, Empty-Moves nor emits an element other than the cost element; any of those breaks it and the permanent falls.

effects.description: Damage the caster takes this action: none.
Every subsequent action the channel re-fires its leg (take no damage this action + a Concentration bonus token on my tile) with the caster's current stats, at no further cost, until broken.
The channel permanent stands on the SMALLEST die of its placement roll (Rule 24 threshold).

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_concentration (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).
